source.name: LaunchLoom owned design study
source.rightsEvidence: This is a LaunchLoom-owned original design study and its in-house rendered capture, stored for internal inspiration and implementation research.

heroGeometry.mode: centered narrow service statement above an offset photo mosaic
heroGeometry.alignment: compact editorial column with image tiles
heroGeometry.viewport: headline, summary, and primary action fit the opening

typography.scale: moderate display size with tight field notes

palette.contrastIntent: clear utility contrast with restrained trade accent

imageTreatment.mode: two horizontal project crops with staggered alignment
imageTreatment.crop: wide rectangles with one supporting tile

mobileRecomposition.strategy: centered narrow column with stacked work
rules: put image tiles after the opening copy
keep service descriptions to one sentence

prohibitedPatterns: service process hidden below long copy

requiredSignatureElements.description: direct list of service or repair options

acceptanceChecks: headline remains balanced at desktop and mobile widths
photos sit directly after the promise
the service list is plain and easy to scan
referenceDna.annotatedDescription: Owned rendered garage-door service study. The screenshot shows a centered field-service promise, project photo tiles, and a plain repair index. It is not a liquid-glass or digital-studio reference.

review.scope: paired full-page evidence and transferable visual mechanics; not approval of sample business claims or production copy
